_about: Mutation-test targets for this plugin. Each target names the file to mutate and
the test command that must notice a change (the fast module that covers it).
Run with tools/mutator.py, or as part of tools/run_tests.sh.
min_kill_rate is the floor: below it the run fails, and a target that yields no
mutants at all fails too, so a mutation pass can never be green over nothing.
Files this repository ships but cannot meaningfully mutate here are listed under
'exempt' with a reason, which the policy check enforces.

equivalent.reason: PROFILE=$(...) || true -> && true: when the profile finder fails the substitution is the non-final operand of an && list, so bash suppresses set -e exactly as it does for ||; both forms leave PROFILE empty and fall through to the same guard. Not observable.

PROFILE=$(...) || true -> && true: the failing substitution is the non-final operand of an && list, so set -e is suppressed exactly as for ||; both forms continue with an empty PROFILE and hit the same guard. Not observable.
the mutated digit is the file descriptor in '>&2'; '>&3' only redirects the error message to an unopened fd. Control flow and exit status are unchanged, and no test asserts on the diagnostic stream.

the UMD wrapper's `typeof module === "object" && module.exports` guard: in every environment this file runs in (node's CommonJS loader and the extension's shared background scope) both operands are true, so && and || select the same branch. Not observable.
`parts.length <= 2` in registrable(): changing <= to < only alters the 2-label case, where both branches (join of two parts vs slice(-2) of two parts) produce the same string. Not observable.
`href.indexOf("@") < href.indexOf(host)` in the userinfo check: @ can never occur at the host's start index (a hostname contains no @), so < and <= never differ. Not observable.

the UMD wrapper's `typeof module === "object" && module.exports` guard: both operands are true in every environment this file runs in (node's CommonJS loader and the extension's shared background scope), so && and || select the same branch. Not observable.

exempt.reason: Thunderbird WebExtension glue (browser.* APIs, messageDisplay listener); it cannot run outside a real Thunderbird, so it is pinned by the e2e extension-load test and by manifest/background-order checks in tests/test_unit_extension.py rather than mutated
pure data (the shortener/TLD/brand lists and thresholds); it has no branching to mutate, and its shape is asserted by the engine tests
writes /etc/xdg, /usr/share and /usr/bin as root; no sandbox can run it, so it is pinned by static assertions in tests/shell/test_set_system_default.sh

vendored byte-identical engine tooling, not plugin source; mutating it makes its own self-tests non-terminating (the and->or operator on code_mask's comment guard loops forever), and its shipped self-test only covers ~half its mutants
